data.action: 双手轻柔捧起你的脸颊，金发在海风中纷飞，霞光染透湛蓝眼眸，探头微吻
data.camera: medium close-up, dramatic sunset bokeh, wind swept hair, profound emotional confession
data.description: 【俯瞰大海的海崖白石露台】漫天如梦似幻的粉紫晚霞映照着翻涌的金色海浪。薇尔莉特身着白色夏日连身裙，海风吹散了她编起的发辫，金色长发在霞光中如金色缎带般漫天起伏。她抬起冰凉而精致的银色机械双手，小心翼翼地捧起你的脸庞，在两唇相碰前，轻声诉说着她一生唯一的誓言。
data.lighting: 粉紫与暖金交融的梦幻落日晚霞，水面波光粼粼的逆光反光
data.location: 海滨灯塔旁的白色大理石观海露台
data.promptProse: On the white-stone terrace above the sea, Violet Evergarden gently cups her companion's face in both silver mechanical hands before a quiet kiss. Her white summer dress and blue-ribbon straw hat remain in place while sea wind loosens blonde strands around the brim. The close view includes the terrace edge and waves far below. Pink-violet sunset edges her fingers and dress, with warm reflected sea light reaching the shadowed side of her face.
data.title: 薇尔莉特 · 海崖晚霞的指尖抚触·「我的生命与爱意，全部奉献给您」
